summary: VietnamPlus/VNA reported that on November 8, 2024 Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra said Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet had been informed that Thailand would resume maritime-dispute negotiations under the 2001 MoU once Thailand formed its Joint Technical Committee. She expected the Thai committee to be finalized by November 18; the talks concern the roughly 26,000-square-kilometer overlapping claims area in the Gulf of Thailand.
title: Thailand, Cambodia to resume negotiations on sea disputes
